On Zℓ², a generator with matrix [[1,ℓ],[0,1]] and its ℓ-th power [[1,ℓ²],[0,1]] have the same Qℓ fixed line y=0. Modulo ℓ², (0,1) is fixed by the latter but not the former. nodes.statement: For X over S define NMP(j,X) to mean: for every Y over S with Smooth(Y→S), the restriction map Hom_S(Y,X)→Hom_eta(Y_eta,X_eta), formed by Over.pullback j, is bijective. Testing only sections or only étale test schemes is a weaker condition.
hypotheses: S and eta are Mathlib schemes in one universe; j:eta→S is a fixed scheme morphism; all objects and morphisms are in Over S or Over eta. This abstract prefix does not assert existence for arbitrary j.
proofSteps: Use mathlib:CategoryTheory.Over.pullback to define generic restriction on actual Hom types.
Quantify over every smooth test object and express injectivity and surjectivity of that same map.

For smooth X, a generically identity endomorphism is identity.
For j=id_S, every X over S has NMP; therefore existence for this degenerate j says nothing about arithmetic reduction.

nodes.title: Prime-to-residue full level forces semistability
nodes.statement: For N≥3 invertible in k, trivial inertia on A[N](K_sep) implies semistability over R. In particular, after adjoining full N-torsion one gets semistable reduction at all residue primes not dividing N. This does not claim good reduction.
hypotheses: S is a connected Dedekind scheme with generic point eta and fraction field K; A/K is an abelian variety. Local statements specify the DVR and any excellence/henselian hypothesis separately.
proofSteps: Use R01.2 quasi-unipotence to make a power of each inertia matrix unipotent. The level-N congruence bounds eigenvalues in the valuation ring of Q_ell algebraic closure: at an odd prime divisor of N they lie in 1+ell O, or for the 2-primary case in 1+4 O. No nontrivial root of unity satisfies those bounds, so every eigenvalue is1; apply the monodromy criterion. Torsion-freeness of a scalar unit group alone is not the full matrix argument.
Keep G-level-kernel for the integral matrix argument; finite-level unramifiedness need not kill monodromy.
acceptance: N=2 is excluded; a Tate curve with ord(q) divisible by N can have unramified N-torsion while remaining multiplicative.
